title: Media source _id is the bare content hash, so two tenants ingesting identical media collide on sources._id when a real sink inserts
evidence: hosted-recording.ts and youtube.ts set source._id = hash and media _id = hash-media with no tenant component. The intake planner looks up sessions by (tenantId, sourceId), so tenant B sees no existing session and calls save; a store with a global _id unique index would reject the insert (test: same media in tenant-a and tenant-b is planned as created for both; the in-memory sink has no unique index).
fix_direction: Before any real sink or API wiring: tenant-scoped source _id (e.g. tenantId + hash) or compound unique (tenantId,_id), with D-135 dedupe keyed on that. Wiring unit must not merge without it.
upgrade_note: Checker cycle 0: probe shows a tenant-scoped find plus a store with a global unique _id makes tenant B's ingest of identical bytes fail with sink-failed only when another tenant already holds it (1-bit cross-tenant existence oracle plus cross-tenant denial of ingest); an upserting save would overwrite tenant A's source doc. Planner dedupe itself is tenant-scoped and does not leak a session id.
verified_evidence: checker t045-tenantid (qa/verdicts/iss-t045intake-001-tenant-scoped-source-id.md) cycle 0 PASS: replay of the issue reproduction, 3/3 adapters (youtube, cloudonair, zoom-recording) resolved; other four adapters tracked as ISS-T045TENANTID-001
